status.description: Publication status on the specification track cycle (e.g., draft, published, deprecated)

version.description: Version identifier of the specification using semver (e.g., '1.0.0', '2.1.0, 1.2.0-rc')

hosted_at.description: Canonical URL where the specification is hosted

workingGroup.description: Associated working group for the publication (object or string ID)

else.description: Reference to a working group identifier
